population.method: ceil(coverage * corpus_total) distinct task cases; no-skill cases count toward the total

skill_coverage.note: Skill coverage is separate from task-case population; multiple sampled skills may share one positive case, and labels may include other full-corpus skills.

labeling.provenance: Agent-authored labels from the exported corpus descriptions before any benchmark retrieval run; no search results or model selections were used.
labeling.relevance_policy: Directly applicable workflows and explicit task aspects; generic style or process advice alone is not a positive judgment.
limitations: Agent-authored tasks are derived from skill descriptions, not a sample of real user traffic.
Metadata judgments are not exhaustive human relevance judgments.
Related skill families can occur in both splits; this does not establish out-of-domain generalization.
labeling.split_method: Connected positive relevance labels assigned together by SHA256(seed plus sorted IDs), 20 percent held-out threshold; negative cases preassigned independently.
